description.summary: This table lists exclusions to Part 1 of a professional liability insurance policy. It details circumstances under which Harel Insurance Company LTD will not indemnify the assured.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת חריגות לפוליסת אחריות מקצועית של הראל חברת ביטוח בע״מ, סעיף 1. החריגות מגדירות מצבים בהם הכיסוי הביטוחי אינו תקף, כגון אירועים שהתרחשו לפני תאריך רטרואקטיבי, נזקים גופניים, מעשים פליליים או הטעיה, קנסות, אחריות הנובעת מהסכמים מפורשים, לשון הרע, אי ציות לחוקים, ועסקי קונטנגו. ניתן לעיין בחרגות אלו כדי להבין את גבולות הכיסוי של הפוליסה. החריגות כוללות: אירועים לפני תאריך רטרואקטיבי, פציעות גופניות, מעשים פליליים, קנסות, אחריות על הסכמים מפורשים, לשון הרע, אי ציות לחוקים, עסקי קונטנגו.

The Insurer shall  not  be  liable  to  indemnify  the  Assured,  under  this  part  of  the  Policy against any Claim or Claims:
(a)    Arising out of any event occurring prior to the retroactive date (if any) specified in the Schedule.
(b) For  bodily  injury,  sickness,  disease  or  death  sustained  by  any  person,  or  any physical damage or destruction of property other than securities or cash.
(c) Arising out of any dishonest, fraudulent, criminal or malicious act or omission of any director or partner of the Assured.
(d) For fines, punitive, penalties or exemplary damages.
…
(g) Arising out of any transactions carried out for or on behalf of any partner director, associate member or employee of the Assured, as well as institutions or companies where the Assured has a controlling interest.
(h) Arising  from  any  liability  assumed  by  the  Assured  under  any  express  warranty, agreement or guarantee, unless such liability would have attached to the Assured notwithstanding such express warranty, agreement or guarantee.
(I) For libel  or  slander  made  by  any  partner  or  employee  of  the  Assured  against  the Assured or against any other partner or employee.
(j)    Arising out of the intentional failure of the Assured to comply with the provisions of any statue, including any regulations made  thereunder, or with any laws, regulations  or  requirements  laid  down  by  any  regulatory  or  supervisory  body  or agency, whether governmental or otherwise.
(k) For  any  loss  to  any  person  or  body  sustained  solely  in  consequence  of  any direction by any regulatory or supervisory body, whether governmental or otherwise.
(L) Arising out of contango business.

טבלה: חרגות לפוליסה - אחריות מקצועית
This table lists exclusions to Part 1 of a professional liability insurance policy. It details circumstances under which Harel Insurance Company LTD will not indemnify the assured.
ממדים: exclusion clause, description of exclusion

Exclusions to Part 1
The Insurer shall  not  be  liable  to  indemnify  the  Assured,  under  this  part  of  the  Policy against any Claim or Claims:
(a)    Arising out of any event occurring prior to the retroactive date (if any) specified in the Schedule.
(b) For  bodily  injury,  sickness,  disease  or  death  sustained  by  any  person,  or  any physical damage or destruction of property other than securities or cash.
(c) Arising out of any dishonest, fraudulent, criminal or malicious act or omission of any director or partner of the Assured.
(d) For fines, punitive, penalties or exemplary damages.
(e) Arising out of the insolvency or bankruptcy of the Assured.
(f) Arising  out  of  financial  and/or  investment  advice  or  on  representations  advice  or forecasts given by the Assured or by any director, officer partner or employee on their behalf in respect of investment which fails to perform in accordance with the same, unless negligence, error or omission can be proved.
(g) Arising out of any transactions carried out for or on behalf of any partner director, associate member or employee of the Assured, as well as institutions or companies where the Assured has a controlling interest.
(h) Arising  from  any  liability  assumed  by  the  Assured  under  any  express  warranty, agreement or guarantee, unless such liability would have attached to the Assured notwithstanding such express warranty, agreement or guarantee.
(I) For libel  or  slander  made  by  any  partner  or  employee  of  the  Assured  against  the Assured or against any other partner or employee.
(j)    Arising out of the intentional failure of the Assured to comply with the provisions of any statue, including any regulations made  thereunder, or with any laws, regulations  or  requirements  laid  down  by  any  regulatory  or  supervisory  body  or agency, whether governmental or otherwise.
(k) For  any  loss  to  any  person  or  body  sustained  solely  in  consequence  of  any direction by any regulatory or supervisory body, whether governmental or otherwise.
(L) Arising out of contango business.
